description: The line plot titled “Massive Activation of atten_output_gate” illustrates the maximum activation values across model layers for four distinct components: `attn_output` (blue dashed line), `ffn_output` (green dashed line), `attn_residual` (orange dotted line), and `ffn_residual` (red solid line). The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to approximately 24 with linear spacing and integer tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “Max Activation Value,” ranges from 0 to 400 with linear scaling and tick marks at intervals of 50. All four lines begin near zero at Layer 0 and remain relatively flat through Layer 10. Starting around Layer 15, the red `ffn_residual` line begins a steep upward trend, reaching approximately 390 by Layer 23. The orange `attn_residual` line follows a similar but slightly delayed trajectory, peaking near 260 at Layer 23. In contrast, the blue `attn_output` and green `ffn_output` lines remain low until Layer 20, after which they both rise sharply — the blue line reaching about 110 and the green line reaching about 160 at Layer 23. The plot visually emphasizes the explosive growth in activation values for residual components in later layers, particularly for `ffn_residual`, while output components show delayed but still substantial growth.
